_doc: Point-in-time retrospective. Every input was public on as_of; see sources. Hindsight lives only in outcome.json.
methodology: house v2 (EPP-distance adjustment), 6-section format; retro method r2: scenario inputs derived from dated facts by frozen rules (retro/README.md); pharmaceutical signals

pit_profile.why: 'is a global specialty biopharmaceutical company whose mission is to discover, develop and deliver innovative medicines that help patients prevail over serious diseases.' BEAR.desc: EPS -65.2%/yr (worst year FY05-FY14, capped at 0%); P/E to its 10th pct

BASE.desc: EPS +-5.5%/yr (FY15 guide + margin + buyback); P/E at its 10-yr median

BULL.desc: EPS +0.5%/yr (FY05-FY14 CAGR); P/E holds its 75th pct

XBULL.desc: EPS +83.7%/yr (best 2-yr run FY05-FY14); P/E at its 90th pct

summary: BMY (retrospective, 2015-05-15) ✕ AVOID — Ratio B infx (97.0% downside to Bear $2 / +-34.9% upside to Bull $44) | Adj composite 2.55 vs market 3.11: gap -0.56 [OVERVALUED] | +219% above the EPP floor $21 (21x FY15E $1.01) | Conservative 2-yr case: -56.7% total (-28.3%/yr) | At 67.0x FY15E the 15% hurdle price $89 sits above the BULL case; U.S. revenues +15.8% in Q1 2015, forward revenues -9.3% to -5.5% (FY15 revenue guide); no disruption theme has dated evidence.
